svg.title: Burgenland study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Burgenland; 2: Illmitz; 3: Podersdorf am See; 4: Gols; 5: Frauenkirchen; 6: Purbach am Neusiedler See; 7: Grosshöflein; 8: Rust; 9: Deutschkreutz; 10: Neckenmarkt; 11: Helenenschacht; 12: Klostermarienberg

g.title: 6 · Purbach am Neusiedler See: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
